lineage.description: Hurricane Irma wind gust data were generated by Tropical Storm Risk/UCL using deterministic tropical cyclone modeling. The dataset includes observed/modeled gust footprints through 15 September 2017 and a 120-hour forecast swathe issued 7 September 2017, representing 3-second maximum gust intensities across the Caribbean and Atlantic region.
